author: eliz002
quote:
I used to be excited for this game. Not anymore.
Rockstar does not deserve any of your support after all the stunts they’ve pulled with this game. Making us wait 13 years for an 80-100$ (maybe invisible or stolen) code in a box that only runs at 30 FPS, is a buggy mess at launch, and is just average at best.
Not to mention, bribing and shilling your way to the top is the most disingenuous thing ever. Blacklisting people who don’t leave a glowing review is cowardly. As a AAA game studio, Rockstar should be able to handle criticism to make their games genuinely good.
But they can’t, so be prepared for The Paid Off Awards this December, and the godawful future of triple A gaming that they are so greedily creating for us.

author: eliz002
quote: This remake was perfect in every way. Such a faithful adaptation, a perfect mix of new content while staying true to the original. The graphics, art style, and soundtrack had me gazing at my TV screen in absolute awe. Gameplay is smooth like butter, it never felt clunky at any point. I did not want the game to end at all, but when I got there it brought me to tears. This remake is a masterpiece and Ocarina of Time remains the greatest game of all time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: eliz002
quote: No better way to describe it than the best game of all time. The most innovative and inspiring game in history.
